node.title: Re: Installation error; INSTALL.pl program is unable to unzip downloaded file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [cookersjs],

I seem to be unable to reproduce this; downloading the file from the URL https://github.com/bioperl/bioperl-live/archive/release-1-6-924.zip, even when I use [mod://LWP::Simple] in the same way that INSTALL.pl does, I get a file that [man://unzip]s without errors. Perhaps it was just a temporary error, and you could try downloading the file again. You might also try looking at what the file you downloaded actually contains, for example with hexdump -C file.zip | head -50. Or, perhaps you could try upgrading your [mod://LWP::Simple], [mod://LWP::Protocol::https] and [mod://Archive::Zip].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
